reasoning_content:
All 20 API generation tasks succeeded (✔), and `generate-map-glyphs` also succeeded. The only failure is the NX DB transaction error (SqliteFailure FOREIGN KEY constraint) — this is an Nx daemon/cache issue, not a failure of the generation tasks themselves. This is a known issue where the Nx daemon's sqlite cache can be corrupted or hit a constraint. This happens after all tasks succeed, at the point when Nx is trying to write the results to the DB.

In other words, all the actual code generation completed. The error is in the Nx daemon's internal DB. Let's reset the NX daemon and cache to fix it, then re-run `pnpm install` (the generation is cached, so it should just link and finish).

Let's try resetting the nx daemon.

action.command: cd /workspace/app && pkill -f "nx" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; echo "=== stop nx daemon ==="; pnpm nx reset 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "=== remove nx cache/temp ==="; rm -rf /workspace/app/.nx 2>/dev/null; rm -rf /workspace/app/node_modules/.cache/nx 2>/dev/null; rm -rf /workspace/.nx 2>/dev/null; ls -la /workspace/app/.nx 2>/dev/null || echo ".nx removed"
